_about: Which built-in Wonderdraft art family becomes which installed pack folder (packswap.py). 'match' says which measured dimension the new art copies: area (trees), width (mountains, hills, dunes: ranges are built side by side), height. 'size' fine-tunes after a look at the test export. First rule whose 'from' prefixes the texture wins. Chosen 2026-09-26: Dotty classic for trees and dunes, Moulk's engraved art for mountains and hills.
